Package net.elgerelg.cozyvoicechat.api.server

Interface ServerVoiceApi

public interface ServerVoiceApi
Server-side Cozy Voice Chat API, from CozyVoiceApi.get().server().

All methods are thread-safe unless stated otherwise. Mutes, effects and "hear yourself" are kept in memory until the server restarts, exactly like the /cozyvoice command.

Side: logical server. On a client connected to a remote server these methods see no players and change nothing; use ClientVoiceApi there.

Since:
1.1.0
